_comment: Native libraries in the iOS binary that no npm package's licence covers (read by scripts/gen-licences.mjs).
Kept by hand. React Native 0.88 ships them prebuilt in ReactNativeDependencies.xcframework
(ios/Pods/ReactNativeDependencies-artifacts), which holds no licence files, and ios/Pods has none of their sources.
Texts: each project's licence file at that version's tag (url below), fetched 2026-11-09; hermes.txt is
ios/Pods/hermes-engine/LICENSE; folly.txt is folly's LICENSE with Meta's copyright line from its source headers on top.
REVIEW ON EVERY REACT NATIVE UPGRADE: versions and the set of libraries change with it.
noticeRequired false: the licence asks for no notice in a compiled binary (Boost 1.0; SQLite is public domain). Listed anyway.

libraries.name: SQLite
libraries.text: SQLite is in the public domain. https://sqlite.org/copyright.html
